#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Focused published stream-search validation; never changes source files."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path('/Users/lanxingcan/Workspace/zstdoxize')
PREFIX = '/tmp/zstdoxide-module11-stream'
OUT = Path(PREFIX + '-evidence.json')
FEATURES = 'unsafe-byte-cursor,unsafe-bitstream,unsafe-history,unsafe-ring-history,unsafe-fse,unsafe-fse-encoder,unsafe-huffman,unsafe-huffman-codebook,unsafe-match-table,unsafe-match-chain,unsafe-dictionary,unsafe-training'

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def summaries(output):
    return [dict(zip(('passed', 'failed', 'ignored', 'measured', 'filtered_out'), map(int, row)))
            for row in re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; (\d+) measured; (\d+) filtered out;', output)]

def main():
    source = ROOT / 'src/stream_encode.rs'
    before = sha(source)
    if before != '2dce0e577d03aca28796f7b724202a92ac73106c5d57561ca5d625dbc3842d9e':
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected owned source')
    env_fields = {'CARGO_TARGET_DIR': '/tmp/zstdoxide-module11-stream-target', 'CARGO_TERM_COLOR': 'never'}
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.update(env_fields)
    evidence = {'schema': 1, 'owned_source': 'src/stream_encode.rs', 'source_sha256_before': before,
        'scope': 'Focused public stream-search library tests; shared repository dependencies may advance independently.',
        'head_before': subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),
        'environment': env_fields, 'runner': {'path': __file__, 'sha256': sha(__file__)},
        'commands': [], 'completed': False}
    initial = Path(PREFIX + '-initial.log')
    initial_summary = summaries(initial.read_text())
    if initial_summary != [{'passed':31,'failed':0,'ignored':1,'measured':0,'filtered_out':543}]:
        raise RuntimeError('Initial checked run did not have expected results')
    evidence['commands'].append({'name':'safe-initial', 'command':['cargo','+nightly-2026-10-08','test','--offline','--locked','--lib','stream_encode::tests::'],
        'cwd':str(ROOT),'exit_code':0,'seconds':None,'timing_note':'Initial exec command had no complete wall-time capture.',
        'summaries':initial_summary,'log':str(initial),'log_sha256':sha(initial)})
    commands = []
    for name, features in [
        ('table',['--features','unsafe-match-table']), ('chain',['--features','unsafe-match-chain']),
        ('ring',['--features','unsafe-ring-history']), ('dictionary',['--features','unsafe-dictionary']),
        ('all',['--all-features']), ('no-std-safe',['--no-default-features']),
        ('no-std-all',['--no-default-features','--features',FEATURES]),
    ]:
        commands.append((name, ['cargo','+nightly-2026-10-08','test','--offline','--locked','--lib',*features,'stream_encode::tests::'], True))
    for name, features in [('safe',[]),('all',['--features',FEATURES])]:
        commands.append(('check-no-std-'+name, ['cargo','+nightly-2026-10-08','check','--offline','--locked','--lib','--no-default-features',*features], False))
    for name, features in [('safe',[]),('all',['--all-features'])]:
        commands.append(('clippy-lib-'+name,['cargo','+nightly-2026-10-08','clippy','--offline','--locked','--lib',*features,'--','-D','warnings'],False))
    commands += [
        ('format',['rustfmt','+nightly-2026-10-08','--edition','2024','--check','src/stream_encode.rs'],False),
        ('diff-check',['git','diff','--check','--','src/stream_encode.rs'],False),
    ]
    def save(): OUT.write_text(json.dumps(evidence,indent=2)+'\n')
    save()
    for name, command, is_test in commands:
        if sha(source) != before: raise RuntimeError('Owned source changed before '+name)
        log = Path(PREFIX+'-'+name+'.log')
        start = time.monotonic()
        print('START '+name,flush=True)
        with log.open('wb') as handle:
            result = subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,env=env,stdout=handle,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        elapsed=time.monotonic()-start
        parsed=summaries(log.read_text())
        passed=sum(s['passed'] for s in parsed)
        ignored=sum(s['ignored'] for s in parsed)
        valid=result.returncode==0 and (not is_test or (passed==31 and ignored==1))
        evidence['commands'].append({'name':name,'command':command,'cwd':str(ROOT),'exit_code':result.returncode,
            'seconds':round(elapsed,4),'summaries':parsed,'expected_count_guard':valid,
            'log':str(log),'log_sha256':sha(log),'source_sha256_after':sha(source)})
        save()
        print(f'END {name} exit={result.returncode} passed={passed} ignored={ignored} guard={valid}',flush=True)
        if not valid: raise RuntimeError('Check failed: '+name)
    evidence['head_after']=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
    evidence['source_sha256_after']=sha(source)
    evidence['source_unchanged']=sha(source)==before
    evidence['passed']=sum(s['passed'] for c in evidence['commands'] for s in c['summaries'])
    evidence['ignored']=sum(s['ignored'] for c in evidence['commands'] for s in c['summaries'])
    evidence['completed']=sha(source)==before
    save()
    print('EVIDENCE '+str(OUT)+' sha256='+sha(OUT),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__': main()
